name: 🎉 BUNDLES + NEW YEARS Trade Tower
desc:
❗The owner of Trade Tower, Colton, tragically passed away in the hospital on July 18th of 2023. He was in the hospital for several months following a car accident. 

The main scripter for this game and group is currently not working on this project and doesn't plan to in the foreseeable future. However, we may continue to make more projects on the Fund Studio group, even in light of the death of the owner. Keep posted on the group if you want to see anything more from us. Thank you for playing with all of us. It was wonderful while it lasted.
